description: GitaGuide retrieval gold set. 40 queries stratified by intent; 2-5 acceptable verse ids each, graded 2 (primary) or 1 (acceptable). A query counts as a hit if ANY acceptable id is retrieved - near-synonymous verses are common (BG-2.47 and BG-3.19 teach the same thing), so single-id grading measured wording luck rather than retrieval. Each id carries a text fingerprint; the eval harness warns when a rebuilt corpus moves an id out from under it. No crisis queries: those short-circuit at the safety gate before retrieval.
